blocks.en: 89.1 Definition and Epidemiology HL is a malignancy arising from germinal centre or post-germinal centre B cells. The cancer cells form a minority of the tumour and are surrounded by a reactive inflammatory milieu comprising lymphocytes, eosinophils, neutrophils, histiocytes and plasma cells. These malignant cells can be pathognomonic, multinucleate giant cells or large mononuclear cells and, together, are referred to as Hodgkin and Reed–Sternberg (HRS) cells. HL accounts for approximately 10% of cases of newly diagnosed lymphoma. The incidence of HL in Europe is 2.2 per 100,000 per year with a mortality rate of 0.7 cases/100,000 a year. The disease is more frequent in men than in women, and peaks in incidence are noted in young adults and in people older than 60 years. Incidence has remained mostly unchanged during the past two decades.
blocks.zh: 〔89.1 定義與流行病學〕HL 是源自生發中心或生發中心後 B 細胞的惡性腫瘤。癌細胞僅占腫瘤少數，周圍環繞由淋巴球、嗜酸性球、嗜中性球、組織球與漿細胞構成的反應性發炎微環境。惡性細胞可為具特徵性的多核巨細胞或大型單核細胞，合稱 Hodgkin 與 Reed–Sternberg（HRS）細胞。HL 約占新診斷淋巴瘤的 10%。歐洲每年發生率為每 100,000 人 2.2 例，死亡率為每 100,000 人 0.7 例。男性較女性常見；發生率在年輕成人及 60 歲以上族群達高峰，過去二十年大致未變。

blocks.en: 89.2 Diagnosis Pathological diagnosis should be made according to the WHO classification from a sufficiently large surgical specimen or excisional lymph node biopsy to provide enough material for fresh frozen and formalin-fixed samples (Eichenauer et al. 2014).
blocks.zh: 89.2 診斷 應根據 WHO 分類，從足夠大的手術標本或切除淋巴結活檢中進行病理診斷，為新鮮冷凍和福馬林固定樣本提供足夠的材料（Eichenauer 等，2014）。

blocks.en: 89.3 Classification HL is classified as either classical (cHL, defined by the presence of HRS cells) or nodular lymphocytepredominant (NLPHL). The immunophenotype of the malignant cells in cHL and NLPHL differs significantly and helps to establish the diagnosis. Four subtypes of cHL exist (nodular sclerosis, mixed cellularity, rich in lymphocytes and lymphocyte depleted), which differ in presentation, sites of involvement, epidemiology and association with EBV. Management, however, is broadly similar in all subtypes. NLPHL has a distinct clinical course, and it only represents less than 5% of the cases of HL. While in the recent fifth edition of the World Health Organization Classification of Haematolymphoid Tumours NLPHL remains an essentially
blocks.zh: 89.3 分類 HL 分為經典型（cHL，由 HRS 細胞的存在定義）或結節性淋巴球為主型 (NLPHL)。 cHL和NLPHL惡性細胞的免疫表型差異顯著，有助於診斷。 cHL 存在四種亞型（結節性硬化症、混合細胞性、富含淋巴細胞和淋巴細胞耗盡），它們在表現、受累部位、流行病學以及與 EBV 的關聯方面有所不同。然而，所有亞型的管理大致相似。 NLPHL 具有獨特的臨床病程，僅佔 HL 病例的不到 5%。雖然在最近的第五版世界衛生組織血淋巴腫瘤分類中，NLPHL 仍然是本質上的分類。

blocks.en: unchanged diagnostic entity, in the 2022 International Consensus Classification of Mature Lymphoid Neoplasms, NLPHL is now renamed nodular lymphocyte predominant B cell lymphoma (NLPBL) in recognition of the distinct pathologic, biologic and clinical differences (Alaggio et al. 2022; Campo et al. 2022).
blocks.zh: 診斷實體不變，在 2022 年國際成熟淋巴腫瘤共識分類中，NLPHL 現更名為結節性淋巴細胞為主的 B 細胞淋巴瘤 (NLPBL)，以認識到明顯的病理、生物學和臨床差異（Alaggio 等人，2022 年；Campo 等人，2022 年）。

blocks.en: 89.4 Risk Factors The outlook for patients with early-stage disease (stages I–IIA) is excellent, with OS exceeding 90% in many trials. In advanced-stage disease (IIB, III–IV), OS is 75–90%. Risk factors for patients with early-stage disease are size of mediastinal mass, age, erythrocyte sedimentation rate, number of nodal areas, B symptoms and mixed cellularity or lymphocyte-depleted histology. Different risk stratification systems combining these factors are defined by the EORTC, GHSG, NCCN and National Cancer Institute of Canada and are currently used in clinical practice. Risk factors for advanced stages consist of albumin <4 g/dL, haemoglobin <10.5 g/dL, male, age ≥45 years, stage IV disease, leucocytosis ≥15 × 10^9/L and lymphocytopenia (lymphocyte count less than 8% of white blood cell count and/or lymphocyte count less than 0.6 × 10^9/L) (International Prognosis Score, 1 point per factor) (Eichenauer et al. 2014).
blocks.zh: 〔89.4 危險因子〕早期疾病（I–IIA 期）預後極佳，許多試驗的 OS 超過 90%；晚期疾病（IIB、III–IV 期）的 OS 為 75–90%。早期疾病的危險因子包括縱膈腫塊大小、年齡、紅血球沉降速率、淋巴結區數、B 症狀，以及混合細胞型或淋巴球耗竭型組織學。EORTC、GHSG、NCCN 與加拿大國家癌症研究所分別建立整合這些因子的風險分層系統，現均用於臨床。晚期疾病危險因子包括白蛋白 <4 g/dL、血紅素 <10.5 g/dL、男性、年齡 ≥45 歲、IV 期、白血球 ≥15 × 10^9/L，以及淋巴球減少（淋巴球低於白血球的 8%，及／或絕對淋巴球 <0.6 × 10^9/L）；國際預後評分每項 1 分（Eichenauer et al. 2014）。

blocks.en: 89.5 First-Line Treatment The treatment of patients with cHL is primarily guided by the clinical stage and prognostic factors of disease. Patients with early-stage disease are usually treated with a combination of chemotherapy (ABVD) plus RTx. The amount of chemotherapy and dose of radiation differ for patients with favourable and unfavourable prognosis of disease. Chemotherapy (ABVD, escalated BEACOPP or Stanford V) was the main treatment for patients with advanced stage, and RTx may be used for selected patients as consolidation (Eichenauer et al. 2014). PET-CT scan adapted therapy is increasingly used allowing treatment de-escalation to decrease toxicity or escalation in case of insufficient tumour control (Johnson et al. 2016; Casasnovas et al. 2019). Data from the Echelon-1 study demonstrated improved overall survival in first-line therapy of advanced HL when replacing bleomycine inABVD with brentuximab vedotin (Ansell et al. 2022).
blocks.zh: 89.5 第一線治療 cHL 患者的治療主要以疾病的臨床分期和預後因素為指導。早期疾病患者通常接受化療 (ABVD) 加 RTx 的合併治療。對於疾病預後良好和不良的患者，化療量和放療劑量有所不同。化療（ABVD、升級BEACOPP 或Stanford V）是晚期患者的主要治療方法，RTx 可用於某些患者作為鞏固治療（Eichenauer 等，2014）。 PET-CT 掃描適應療法越來越多地使用，允許治療降級以減少毒性或在腫瘤控制不足的情況下升級（Johnson 等人，2016 年；Casasnovas 等人，2019 年）。 Echelon-1 研究的數據表明，當用 brentuximab vedotin 取代 ABVD 中的博萊黴素時，晚期 HL 一線治療的總體生存率得到改善（Ansell 等人，2022）。

blocks.en: Table 89.1 Principles of management of relapse or refractory cHL New biopsy – Mandatory if relapse is ≥12 months after the end of primary treatment in order to exclude alternative diagnoses. Highly recommended for patients with suspected relapse <12 months – If apparent primary refractory disease, histological confirmation of HL is only recommended if progression is suspected within new sites of disease.
blocks.zh: 表 89.1 復發或難治性 cHL 的處理原則 新活檢 – 如果在主要治療結束後 ≥12 個月內復發，則必須進行新活檢，以排除其他診斷。強烈建議疑似復發 <12 個月的患者 – 如果有明顯的原發性難治性疾病，只有在新的疾病部位懷疑有進展時，才建議對 HL 進行組織學確認。

blocks.en: Biopsy may not be mandatory in patients with clear radiological progression in sites of primary disease during treatment Radiological evaluation – A whole-body CT scan with contrast dye injection and a PET are recommended for further comparison Therapy – Salvage therapy followed by high-dose chemotherapy and auto-HCT is currently considered the standard of care for relapsed cHL patients – No study has compared effectiveness of different salvage regimens – Salvage strategy should be tailored on an individual basis taking into account the initial therapy given, the risk of adding cumulative non-haematologic toxicity and the possibility of harvesting stem cells – Cardiac and pulmonary function should be evaluated prior to treatment – If indicated, reproductive counselling should be proposed prior to treatment – Objective of salvage chemotherapy: to produce a response (tumour remains chemosensitive), which has a major impact on post-auto-HCT outcome. Achievement of PET negativity defines chemosensitivity and should be the goal of salvage chemotherapy
blocks.zh: 對於治療期間原發部位有明顯放射學進展的患者，可能不需要進行活檢 放射學評估 – 建議進行全身 CT 掃描，注射對比染料和 PET 進行進一步比較 治療 – 搶救治療後進行大劑量化療和自體 HCT 目前被認為是復發性 cHL 患者的護理標準 – 沒有研究比較不同治療方案的有效性治療前應評估心臟和肺功能 – 如果有指徵，應在治療前提出生殖諮詢 – 挽救性化療的目標：產生反應（腫瘤仍對化學敏感），這對自體 HCT 後的結果有重大影響。 PET 陰性的實現定義了化療敏感性，並且應該是挽救性化療的目標

blocks.en: chemotherapybased salvage regimens are associated with haematologic toxicity. Infection and neutropenic fever are reported in 10–24% of cases. Nephrotoxicity, hepatotoxicity, mucositis and gastrointestinal toxicity are observed in <10%. Haematopoietic stem cell mobilization appears adequate with all regimens. Efficacy of different salvage options is shown in Table 89.2.
blocks.zh: 基於化療的挽救方案與血液學毒性有關。 10-24% 的病例報告有感染和嗜中性球減少性發燒。觀察到腎毒性、肝毒性、黏膜炎和胃腸道毒性的發生率<10%。所有方案的造血幹細胞動員似乎都足夠。不同救助方案的效果如表 89.2 所示。

blocks.en: 89.7 Autologous HCT Auto-HCT is currently considered the standard treatment for relapsed/refractory (R/R) cHL patients. Two landmark randomized clinical trials, the British National Lymphoma Investigation (BNLI) in 1993 and the joint German Hodgkin Study Group (GHSG)/EBMT HD-R1 trial in 2002, compared high-dose chemotherapy followed by auto-HCT versus chemotherapy and showed significant a benefit of auto-HCT in terms of EFS and FFTF in front of conventional salvage chemotherapy; however, there was no significant OS benefit. EBMT current indications for autologous HCT in HL are shown in
blocks.zh: 89.7 自體 HCT 自體 HCT 目前被認為是復發/難治性 (R/R) cHL 患者的標準治療方法。兩項具有里程碑意義的隨機臨床試驗，即 1993 年的英國國家淋巴瘤調查 (BNLI) 和 2002 年的德國霍奇金研究組 (GHSG)/EBMT HD-R1 聯合試驗，比較了高劑量化療後進行的自體 HCT 與化療，結果表明，在 EFS 和 FFTF 方面，自體 HCT 優於傳統化療的優勢；然而，沒有顯著性提高作業系統。 HL 中自體 HCT 的 EBMT 目前適應症見

blocks.zh: 表 89.3（Snowden 等人，2022 年）。

blocks.en: 89.7.1 Stem Cell Source and Conditioning Regimen Haematopoietic stem cells from mobilized PB are the preferred stem cell source for auto-HCT. Although the choice of preparative regimen varies and is typically based on institutional experience, BEAM is the preferred option. Standard BEAM consists of BCNU (300 mg/ m² × 1, day −6), VP (200 mg/m² , days −5 to −2), Ara-C (200 mg/m² bid, days −5 to −2) and MEL (140 mg/kg/day × 1, days −1). The CY, BCNU and VP (CBV) regimen is also commonly used in North America. The use of TBI-based regimens is not recommended due to the higher risk of developing secondary malignancies.
blocks.zh: 89.7.1 幹細胞來源和調理方案 來自動員的 PB 的造血幹細胞是自體 HCT 的首選幹細胞來源。儘管準備方案的選擇各不相同並且通常基於機構經驗，但 BEAM 是首選。標準 BEAM 包括 BCNU（300 mg/m² × 1，第 -6 天）、VP（200 mg/m²，第 -5 至 -2 天）、Ara-C（200 mg/m² bid，第 -5 至 -2 天）和 MEL（140 mg/kg/天 × 1，第 -1 天）。 CY、BCNU 和 VP (CBV) 方案在北美也常用。不建議使用基於 TBI 的治療方案，因為發生繼發性惡性腫瘤的風險較高。

blocks.en: Late toxicities of BEAM include pulmonary complications (chronic interstitial fibrosis and decrease in lung diffusing capacity, 21%), infection (30%), metabolic syndrome (17%), cardiovascular complications (12%), secondary tumours (20%) and other toxicities (20%). The most frequent cause of NRM is subsequent malignancy (12-fold increased risk compared with the general population).
blocks.zh: BEAM的晚期毒性包括肺部併發症（慢性間質纖維化和肺部彌散能力下降，21%）、感染（30%）、代謝症候群（17%）、心血管併發症（12%）、繼發性腫瘤（20%）和其他毒性（20%）。 NRM 最常見的原因是隨後發生的惡性腫瘤（與一般人群相比，風險增加 12 倍）。

blocks.en: 89.7.2 Prognostic Factors Adverse prognostic factors for post-auto-HCT outcome consistent across many reported trials included primary induction failure, initial remission duration of <3 months, relapse within 12 months of induction therapy, extranodal disease, B symptoms, advanced stage at relapse, resistance to salvage chemotherapy and persistent disease at the time of transplant.
blocks.zh: 89.7.2 預後因素 許多報告試驗一致的自體 HCT 後結果的不良預後因素包括初次誘導失敗、初始緩解持續時間 <3 個月、誘導治療 12 個月內復發、結外疾病、B 症狀、復發晚期、對挽救性化療耐藥和移植時持續性疾病。

blocks.en: 89.7.3 Results of Auto-HCT Disease status pre-auto-HCT NRM (%) OS at 5 years (%) PFS at 5 years (%) Chemosensitive disease 0–18 75 50 Primary refractory disease 0–18 30–36 15–38
blocks.zh: 〔89.7.3 自體 HCT 結果〕自體 HCT 前疾病狀態／NRM／5 年 OS／5 年 PFS：化療敏感性疾病為 0–18%／75%／50%；原發難治性疾病為 0–18%／30–36%／15–38%。

blocks.en: 89.7.4 Consolidation Treatment After Auto-HCT Brentuximab vedotin (BV) is currently the only drug approved for consolidation treatment after auto-HCT in patients at risk of relapse or progression. This approval was obtained after the results of the phase III AETHERA trial. In this multicentre randomized trial, 329 patients with relapsed or refractory HL were allocated to either consolidation therapy of up to 16 cycles of BV or placebo after auto-HCT. PFS was significantly longer in patients in the BV group (median PFS 43 months vs. 24 months, P = 0.0013). When patients were grouped by the number of risk factors, a higher number led to more notable benefits in the consolidation arm (Moskowitz et al. 2015).
blocks.zh: 89.7.4 自體 HCT 後的鞏固治療 Brentuximab vedotin (BV) 是目前唯一被批准用於有復發或進展風險的患者在自體 HCT 後鞏固治療的藥物。該批准是在 III 期 AETHERA 試驗結果出來後獲得的。在這項多中心隨機試驗中，329 名復發或難治性 HL 患者在自體 HCT 後被分配接受最多 16 個週期的 BV 鞏固治療或安慰劑。 BV 組患者的 PFS 顯著較長（中位 PFS 為 43 個月 vs. 24 個月，P = 0.0013）。當病人依照危險因子的數量進行分組時，危險因子的數量越多，鞏固組的益處就越顯著（Moskowitz et al. 2015）。

blocks.en: 89.8 Tandem Auto-HCT Several groups have explored a tandem transplant approach to improve post-transplant outcomes of patients with poor risk factors. These studies showed that tandem auto-HCT is feasible and associated with a NRM of 0–5%, 5-year OS of 54–84% and 5-year PFS of 49–55% (Smith et al. 2018). According to these results, risk-adapted tandem auto-HCT can be considered an option for poor-risk patients, but integration of PET findings and new drugs such as BV and checkpoint inhibitors may help to refine the need for a second auto-HCT and possibly improve outcomes of these patients.
blocks.zh: 89.8 串聯自體 HCT 多個小組已經探索了串聯移植方法，以改善具有不良危險因子的患者的移植後結果。這些研究表明，串聯自體 HCT 是可行的，並且與 0-5% 的 NRM、54-84% 的 5 年 OS 和 49-55% 的 5 年 PFS 相關（Smith 等人，2018）。根據這些結果，風險適應串聯自體 HCT 可以被視為低風險患者的一種選擇，但將 PET 結果與 BV 和檢查點抑制劑等新藥相結合可能有助於完善第二次自體 HCT 的需求，並可能改善這些患者的預後。

blocks.en: 89.9 Disease Relapse After Auto-HCT Patients relapsing following auto-HCT used to have an overall poor prognosis. Early relapse, stage IV, bulky disease, poor performance status and age ≥50 years at auto-HCT failure have been identified as predictors of poor outcome (Jethava et al. 2017; Kallam and Armitage 2018; Lapo and Blum 2016). Recently, a large retrospective analysis from the EBMT that included 1781 adult patients with relapsed cHL after auto HCT over a period of 12 years, noted a significant improvement in the 4-year OS after relapse, which increased from 32% in patients who relapsed between 2006 and 2008 to 63% in those who relapsed between 2015 and 2017 (Bazarbachi et al. 2022). In this study, survival increased with the length of time between auto-HCT and relapse, whereas increasing age, poor performance status, bulky disease, extranodal disease and presence of B-symptoms at relapse were associated with a worse OS (Bazarbachi et al. 2022). Therapeutic options are very heterogeneous (Table 89.4) (Martínez et al. 2013; Hahn et al. 2013).
blocks.zh: 〔89.9 自體 HCT 後疾病復發〕過去，自體 HCT 後復發患者的整體預後不佳。早期復發、IV 期、腫瘤體積大、體能狀態不佳及自體 HCT 失敗時年齡 ≥50 歲，均是不良結果的預測因子（Jethava et al. 2017；Kallam and Armitage 2018；Lapo and Blum 2016）。EBMT 最近一項納入 1781 名成人、涵蓋 12 年的大型回溯分析顯示，復發後 4 年 OS 顯著改善：2006–2008 年復發者為 32%，2015–2017 年復發者升至 63%（Bazarbachi et al. 2022）。存活隨自體 HCT 至復發間隔延長而提高；年齡較大、體能狀態差、bulky disease、結外疾病及復發時有 B 症狀則與較差 OS 相關。可採治療相當異質（表89.4）（Martínez et al. 2013；Hahn et al. 2013）。

blocks.en: 89.10 Allogeneic HCT Allo-HCT is still considered a curative treatment strategy for patients with cHL who relapse or progress after auto-HCT (Peggs et al. 2008). Our knowledge on the curative capacity of allo-HCT relies on the results of several retrospective analyses, some of them registry-based, phase II prospective clinical trials (Sureda et al. 2012) that included low number of patients and retrospective analyses that in a donor-versus-no-donor strategy demonstrate that allo-HCT offers a significant benefit in terms of both PFS and OS. EBMT current indications for allo-HCT in cHL are shown in Table 89.5.
blocks.zh: 89.10 同種異體 HCT 對於自體 HCT 後復發或進展的 cHL 患者，異體 HCT 仍被認為是一種治癒性治療策略（Peggs 等，2008）。我們對 allo-HCT 療效的了解依賴於多項回顧性分析的結果，其中一些是基於註冊的 II 期前瞻性臨床試驗（Sureda 等人，2012 年），其中包括少量患者，而回顧性分析在捐贈者與無捐贈者策略中表明，allo-HCT 在 PFS 和 OS 方面均具有顯著優勢。 cHL 中異基因 HCT 的 EBMT 目前適應症如表 89.5 所示。

blocks.en: 89.10.1 Stem Cell Source, Type of Donor and Conditioning Regimen HSC from mobilized PB are the preferred stem cell source for allo-HCT. The use of haploidentical donors has increased the use of BM in some of the series. Later studies have demonstrated no significant differences in terms of GVHD incidence with the use of PB in this setting. In recent years, there has been a significant increase in the use of haploidentical donors with the introduction of the PT-CY approach. The interesting results observed with this type of transplant have already decreased the use of MUD and MRD in the EBMT reporting centres (Gayoso et al. 2016). Retrospectively, registrybased studies from both EBMT and CIBMTR indicate that outcomes of PT-CY-based haplo- HCT are similar to those of MRD and MUD; cumulative incidence of GVHD seems to be lower with the haploidentical approach and translates into a better PFS-cGVHD in some of the series (Martínez et al. 2017). More than 50% of the patients with HL treated with allo-HCT receive a RIC protocol. RIC regimens have demonstrated to significantly reduce NRM after transplantation but also to increase RI after transplant (Sureda et al. 2008).
blocks.zh: 89.10.1 幹細胞來源、供體類型和調理方案 來自動員 PB 的 HSC 是異體 HCT 的首選幹細胞來源。單倍體供體的使用增加了某些系列中 BM 的使用。後來的研究表明，在這種情況下使用 PB 的 GVHD 發生率沒有顯著差異。近年來，隨著 PT-CY 方法的引入，半相合供體的使用顯著增加。透過這種類型的移植觀察到的有趣結果已經減少了 EBMT 報告中心 MUD 和 MRD 的使用（Gayoso 等人，2016）。回顧性地，EBMT 和 CIBMTR 的註冊研究表明，基於 PT-CY 的單倍體 HCT 的結果與 MRD 和 MUD 的結果相似；單倍體相合方法的 GVHD 累積發生率似乎較低，並且在某些系列中轉化為更好的 PFS-cGVHD（Martínez 等人，2017）。超過 50% 接受異體 HCT 治療的 HL 患者接受 RIC 方案。 RIC 方案已被證明可以顯著降低移植後的 NRM，但也可以增加移植後的 RI（Sureda 等，2008）。

blocks.en: There are no formal prospective clinical trials demonstrating the superiority of a given conditioning protocol in front of the others. Retrospective analysis indicates that low-dose TBI-containing regimens are associated with a higher RI and lower survival than non-TBI-containing protocols. A more recent restrospective analysis from the EBMT registry showed that with modern transplant practices, the NRM associated with MAC for HL has strongly decreased, resulting in a trend towards better EFS compared with RIC transplants (Genadieva- Stavrik et al. 2016). Therefore, an MAC could be an option to be considered on a case-by-case basis.
blocks.zh: 沒有正式的前瞻性臨床試驗證明給定調理方案相對於其他方案的優越性。回顧性分析表明，與不含 TBI 的方案相比，低劑量含 TBI 的方案與較高的 RI 和較低的存活率相關。 EBMT 登記處最近的一項回顧性分析表明，隨著現代移植實踐，與 HL 的 MAC 相關的 NRM 已大幅下降，導致與 RIC 移植相比，EFS 有更好的趨勢（Genadieva-Stavrik 等，2016）。因此，MAC 可能是根據具體情況考慮的選項。

blocks.en: 89.10.2 Prognostic Factors The most important adverse prognostic factor associated with long-term outcome after allo- HCT is the disease status before transplant. However, the impact of a PET-negative CR before the procedure is not as straightforward as in the auto-HCT setting.
blocks.zh: 89.10.2 預後因子 與allo-HCT 後長期結果相關的最重要的不良預後因素是移植前的疾病狀態。然而，手術前 PET 陰性 CR 的影響並不像自體 HCT 設定那樣直接。

blocks.en: 89.10.3 The Use of Allo-HCT in the Era of New Drugs The role and positioning of allo-HCT in patient’s relapsing/progressing after auto-HCT are less clear with the introduction of new drugs. Numbers of allo-HCT for this indication seem to have decreased over the last 2 years. BV has been used as a bridge to allo- HCT. There is no evidence of a need of a washout period between the last dose of BV and day 0 of HCT. The number of BV cycles being given before allo-HCT is usually between four and six. The use of BV before transplant does not modify post-transplant-related toxicities and might improve results by improving performance status and disease status before allo-HCT. It might also allow more patients to successfully go through the transplant and potentially reduce the incidence of chronic GVHD (Bazarbachi et al. 2018). Checkpoint inhibitors (nivolumab, pembrolizumab) before allo-HCT seem very effective with promising survival results (Dada 2018). However, follow-up is still too short, and it has been suggested that their use could be associated with increase in transplant-related toxicity (acute GVHD, SOS/VOD, post-transplant hyperacute febrile syndrome).
blocks.zh: 89.10.3 新藥時代 Allo-HCT 的應用 隨著新藥的推出，allo-HCT 在患者自體 HCT 後復發/進展中的作用和定位不太清楚。在過去 2 年中，用於此適應症的異基因 HCT 數量似乎有所減少。 BV 已被用作異體 HCT 的橋樑。沒有證據表明在最後一次 BV 劑量和 HCT 第 0 天之間需要有一個清除期。 allo-HCT 之前給予的 BV 週期數通常在四到六次之間。移植前使用 BV 不會改變移植後相關毒性，並且可能透過改善異體 HCT 前的體能狀態和疾病狀態來改善結果。它也可能讓更多患者成功接受移植，並有可能降低慢性 GVHD 的發生率（Bazarbachi et al. 2018）。 allo-HCT 先前的檢查點抑制劑（nivolumab、pembrolizumab）似乎非常有效，具有良好的生存結果 (Dada 2018)。然而，追蹤時間仍然太短，有人認為它們的使用可能與移植相關毒性（急性 GVHD、SOS/VOD、移植後超急性發燒綜合症）的增加有關。

blocks.en: It is generally recommended to hold checkpoint inhibitors for at least 6 weeks before allo-HCT and to use PTCY for GVHD prophylaxis. The final decision of whether to allograft a patient that relapses after auto-HCT might rely on the risk profile of the underlying disease as well as the transplant-related risk.
blocks.zh: 一般建議在allo-HCT前保留檢查點抑制劑至少6週，並使用PTCY預防GVHD。是否對自體 HCT 後復發的患者進行異體移植的最終決定可能取決於潛在疾病的風險狀況以及與移植相關的風險。

blocks.en: 89.10.4 Results of Allo-HCT Disease status pre-allo-HCT NRM (%) OS at 3 years (%) PFS at 3 years (%) Chemosensitive disease 15–20 60–70 40–50 Chemorefractory disease 20–30 40–50 20–30
blocks.zh: 〔89.10.4 異體 HCT 結果〕異體 HCT 前疾病狀態／NRM／3 年 OS／3 年 PFS：化療敏感性疾病為 15–20%／60–70%／40–50%；化療難治性疾病為 20–30%／40–50%／20–30%。

blocks.en: 89.10.5 Disease Relapse After Allo-HCT Disease relapse carries out a dim prognosis. Therapeutic options are variable and heterogeneous (Table 89.6), and in some cases, palliative care is the only feasible one.
blocks.zh: 89.10.5 Allo-HCT 後疾病復發 疾病復發的預後較差。治療方案多樣且異質（表 89.6），在某些情況下，安寧療護是唯一可行的治療方案。

blocks.en: Key Points • Auto-HCT is still the standard of care for those patients with primary refractory/chemosensitive first relapse. Results of auto-HCT might improve in the future with better selection of patients, improved results of salvage strategies and consolidation treatment in those patients with high risk of relapse after auto-HCT. • Allo-HCT is the only curative treatment options for those patients relapsing after auto-HCT. The use of allo-HCT is being modified by the introduction of haploidentical donors as well as targeted therapies in this setting.
blocks.zh: 【重點】• 自體 HCT 仍是原發難治性／化療敏感性第一次復發患者的標準治療。未來藉由更精確的患者選擇、更有效的挽救策略，以及對自體 HCT 後高復發風險患者施行鞏固治療，結果可能進一步改善。• 對自體 HCT 後復發者，異體 HCT 是唯一具治癒潛力的治療選項；haploidentical donor 與標靶治療的引入，正改變此情境下異體 HCT 的使用方式。
